name: catalog-publication-cross-surface-readback
objective: Preserve Central Catalog truth while making Marketing the explicit publication owner for field-originated stores/products and proving same-ID cross-surface readback.
truthOwner: Central Catalog owns Master Product/category; DSH owns store assortment/local commercial state and server publication prerequisites; Marketing Control Panel owns publication command/override; Client is read-only.

tasks.objective: Close catalog proposal and publication authority with no shadow master/store/public state.
tasks.currentProblem: Field catalog is central-master based, but publication ownership and review stages can drift across Partners/Catalog/Marketing, and generic marketing was previously excluded despite the approved publication responsibility.
tasks.requiredChange: Keep Field permissions to master selection + store-local price/availability/description + proposals/corrections/image suggestions; route master proposals to Catalog and store assortment to store policy; make Marketing publication use an automatic Composite Publication Gate with audited manual override; remove any Field/Partner direct publish capability and obsolete shadow publication state.
tasks.targetState: Approved intake+readiness+catalog prerequisites produce a publishable candidate; Marketing publishes/overrides through one server-authoritative command; products become client-visible automatically when master+assortment conditions pass; document-critical expiry is policy-driven; suspending the Field provider does not hide an approved store; Partner and Client read the same storeId/productId.
tasks.action: Trace catalog/store/publication APIs/DB/events and all Catalogs/Partners/Marketing pages; centralize gate evaluation and publish command, constrain proposals and overrides, remove duplicate publication writers, then run positive and negative same-ID readback including rejected/hidden/expired/disabled cases.
mustNotChange: Field لا يعدل Master Product مباشرة.
لا direct publish من Field أو Partner.
لا تغيير store/product IDs بين الأسطح.
acceptanceCriteria: Field permissions match approved catalog scope and direct master mutation is impossible.
Marketing is the single publication command surface with audited override.
Server gate rejects incomplete/unapproved states independently of UI.
Product publication follows master approval + assortment conditions.
Positive and negative Partner/Client readback preserve exact IDs and visibility rules.
tasks.rollback: Preserve canonical IDs and gate truth; forward-fix publication policy, never restore a competing writer.
tasks.commitBoundary: Catalog + Marketing publication + required readback coherent batch.
